title: Ya Janabe Sayeda
body:
al madad sayyeda al madad fatema
hum azadaron ki aap se hai ilteja
ya janabe sayyeda ya janabe sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
har hussaini se rahe door har marz o bala
ya janabe sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e imdaad hai aafat ki ghadi hai bibi
maut ban kar ke bala sar pe khadi hai bibi
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
jaaye ghamkhawar kahan aap ke dar ke siwa
ya janabe sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bahot paas mein ab maahe aza shehzadi
har azadaar ye karta hai dua shehzadi
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
ek ishara kar do door ho jaaye waba
ya janabe sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne aulaad bhi bechi hai moharram ke liye
wo pareshan hai shabbir ke matam ke liye
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
jald imadad karo phir biche farshe aza
ya janabe sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ko zainabe muztar ki qasam ya zahra
kar do sarwar ke ghulamon pe karam ya zahra
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
bakshdo ay bibi hai agar koi khata
ya janabe sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath aur payr bahot maar chuki hai dunya
la dawa hai ye maraz haar chuki hai dunya
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
sadqa hasnain ka do ab mile sab ko shifa
ya janabe sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko maloom hai hum aaye hai matam ke liye
hum ko allah ne bheja hai isi gham ke liye
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
ye ibadat hum se hone paaye na qaza
ya janabe sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum agar aap ke bacchon ko na ro payenge
bakhuda chain se ek pal bhi na so payenge
al madad fatema al madad sayyeda
ab madad jald karo hai ye waiz ki dua
ya janabe sayyeda...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
